representation_detail: Each frame is a 13-D binary-spherical code lifted by Linear(13, 256) on its own. Focal blocks are not used. The utterance vector is the mean of those 256-D frames.
reading: Across 3787 utterances and 38 speakers, silhouette is 0.101. B-cubed precision is 0.457, recall is 0.416, and F1 is 0.436, against a speaker-shuffle recall of 0.038 and F1 of 0.040. A silhouette near 1 and a B-cubed F1 well above the shuffle mean the averaged 256-D vector separates these speakers. A silhouette near 0 and an F1 near the shuffle mean the average does not carry speaker identity.
